response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software engineer with a strong web/full-stack and D-language background, but he lacks substantive, recent C++ experience (only a brief 6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015) and shows no evidence of IEC 62443, SDL practices, MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols, or industrial automation domain exposure that this role requires.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience across many domains
Demonstrated systems-level and performance-oriented work (low-latency, async I/O, fibers, high-performance databases)
Strong ownership, mentoring, teaching, and technical communication track record (workshops, talks, open source)
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (~6 months, over 10 years ago) — core requirement of the role
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, industrial cybersecurity, or application security expertise
No exposure to MQTT, message brokers, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.), or industrial automation domain

key_factors.factor: No IoT/MQTT/message-broker or industrial protocol experience
